Summer deals are still going strong with AirPods Pro 3 down $50, AirPods Max 2 down $100, Apple AirTag 2 starting at $22 each, and 9to5Toys' midday highlight today is this 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB of memory down $320, alongside ongoing $500 off the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro, as well as $170 off the lowest-priced 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with the upgraded power brick. Also featured are official Apple USB-C cables starting at $7.50 each, Apple's Black iPhone 17 Pro Max TechWoven MagSafe Case at 32% off (an Amazon all-time low), and more.

This 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB of memory is down $320 today, and the 2TB M5 Pro is $500 off at Amazon

The best MacBook deals right now are almost uncontested — Amazon has taken a massive $500 off the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro, well below the latest pricing. For readers interested in picking up an M5 MacBook Air, we have $200 off the 24GB model, and we also spotted this more affordable Pro model — the 24GB M5 MacBook Pro at $320 off.

B&H is now offering the lowest price yet on the new 24GB MacBook Pro — with 24GB of RAM and 1TB of storage — down to $1,899 with free shipping.

It also ships with the official upgraded 96W charger, which costs an extra $20 to configure when ordering from Apple.com.

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $1,899 (regularly $2,219)
  • Includes the upgraded 96W Apple charger (a $20 value)

That comes out to $2,219 in total at retail, meaning you save $320 and the best offer we have tracked at a reputable retailer. It's worth noting that Amazon has the same model with the standard 70W charger priced at $2,049.

Here are the best MacBook Pro deals this week at a glance:

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,849 (regularly $1,999)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,299 (regularly $2,499)

We're still tracking ongoing $200 off the 24GB M5 MacBook Pro deals, and also spotted a notable discount on the 15-inch base model this morning — priced $150 lower than the former, meaning $170 below MSRP.

As we reported yesterday, Amazon has now taken $100 off nearly every M5 MacBook Air configuration they carry:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,499 (regularly $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,699 (regularly $1,799)

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,699 (regularly $1,799)

However, B&H has also been running solid discounts this week, including the aforementioned 24GB model down to $1,499, as well as this $170 off bundle on the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air base model:

B&H has now dropped the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage to $1,349 with free shipping.

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,349 (regularly $1,519)
  • Includes the upgraded 70W Apple charger (a $20 value)

That comes in $150 below MSRP, $50 less than Amazon, and B&H includes the upgraded 70W Apple charger. Configuring the same machine with that same charger directly from Apple would run you $1,519 — meaning you actually save $170.

If you're looking to upgrade your Apple wearable with $100 off, you'll want to act fast.

Amazon now has the 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 priced at $299 and the 46mm model at $329 with free shipping. That marks $100 off the regular prices of $399 and $429 respectively, and this is for the most basic models.

However, color options for these discounts are starting to dwindle. There are still a few colors available at the discounted price, but it appears the Series 11 summer deals are starting to sell out or rise back up this week.
